_comment: MATRIX API egg for Pterodactyl. Import via Admin → Eggs → Import. Requires a PostgreSQL database (create one in the panel or use an external one).
name: MATRIX API
author: Souzzaaxzy
description: Backend do MATRIX 💤 — Node.js + Fastify + Prisma + PostgreSQL. O install script clona o repositório, instala dependências e compila. O startup (npm start) aplica migrations, popula o banco se vazio, e sobe o servidor. Configure DATABASE_URL e JWT_SECRET nas variáveis.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO_URL="https://github.com/Souzzaaxzy/ServidorMtx.git"
BRANCH="main"

cd /mnt/server

# OpenSSL is required by Prisma's query engine.
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl ca-certificates git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo '>> Cloning repository...'
  git clone --depth 1 -b "$BRANCH" "$REPO_URL" /tmp/matrix-src
  shopt -s dotglob
  mv /tmp/matrix-src/* .
  shopt -u dotglob
  rmdir /tmp/matrix-src 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '>> Repository cloned.'
else
  echo '>> package.json already present — skipping clone.'
fi

echo '>> Installing dependencies...'
npm install --legacy-peer-deps

echo '>> Generating Prisma client...'
./node_modules/.bin/prisma generate

echo '>> Compiling TypeScript...'
npm run build

echo '>> MATRIX API installation complete!'
echo '>> Set DATABASE_URL and JWT_SECRET in the server variables.'

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Create a database in the panel and use the provided URL, or point to an external Postgres. Example: postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/dbname?schema=public

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Secret used to sign JWT access tokens. Use a long random string in production.

variables.name: CORS Origin
variables.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins. Use * for development, or list explicit origins in production.

variables.name: AI Provider
variables.description: Akame AI provider: mock (default, no key needed), openai, or anthropic.

variables.name: AI API Key
variables.description: API key for the AI provider. Leave empty when using mock.
